notice: Separately authorized four-slot H3-only cohort. Not a continuation, completion or repair of the stopped eight-slot cohort; not a native grant or cooperative hold.
intent: Descriptive unchanged baseline timing and output variation only; no candidate/control configurations, same-work performance eligibility or speedup claim.

source_policy.required: Reuse the previously qualified frozen guardian/native build from main f81795607bd986e1e5d63344021cf7af85c4d400, without rebuilding or changing it. Qualify and freeze new CPU-only collector/reporting source before H0.
source_policy.future_bindings: New source/binary/collector/asset/plan/transaction binding documents reference these unchanged protocol bytes. No post-outcome edits.

generation.prompt: A geometric folded-paper sculpture slowly rotates on a plain light background. Static camera, soft studio lighting.

primary_metric.boundary: root creation through root exit/stop decision; includes native codecs and their in-loop settlement, excludes terminal root cleanup and subsequent media inspection; not pure model inference

ordering: H0 retained warmup, then H1 H2 H3 measured. Sequential, one native transaction at a time. No interleaving, reordering, retries, replacements or data-dependent extensions.
warmup_policy: Exactly one retained fresh-process H3 warmup, excluded from measured timing summaries. Administrative exclusion only; cache_policy remains unspecified for all four slots.

failure_policy.partial_policy: Show every planned row and all observed outcomes/times. Label fewer than 3 valid measured primary values incomplete; no fill-in runs. Retain valid subset descriptive values with exact exclusions, never silent drop.
failure_policy.stop_policy: Stop admission on incomplete original settlement/readiness, exhausted/revoked authority, resource/conflict denial, or changed frozen code/asset/settings bindings. Keep remaining fixed slots visibly not_run; no automatic restart or altered-build continuation. Metric magnitude or output differences never change sample count. Stop all future admission if the original standalone collector becomes unavailable, its process/domain changes, or its original bracket cannot be completed. Never reconstruct state/domain, restart that collector for this cohort, or replay an attempt.

each_slot: all original codec/inspection helper settlement where applicable
original service accounting and restoration outcome
receipt-bound qualified per-PID Studio listener/health observer and original observer settlement
validation_and_ownership.service_accounting_limit: Preserve aggregate service_accounting_complete and any dispositions verbatim. Empty per-command disposition arrays are not proof no helpers ran; do not invent detailed lifecycle helper receipts.
validation_and_ownership.readiness: After approved CPU qualification, a narrowly authorized named registration must precede initial receipt-bound per-PID readiness. After each attempt, rebind the already qualified private observer template to the authoritative restored Studio identity before invocation. Only scalar identity and slot/receipt/output-path changes and existing frozen-main rlib/qualified C recipe links are permitted; no old-PID/global/lsof/oMLX scans or lifecycle replay.

timing_report.primary: Exact per-modality phase/scope/unit/method/boundary selectors above; missing/duplicate/changed boundary stays unavailable, never substituted.
secondary: all original adapter timing observations with boundaries and unavailable reasons
manifest host interval, wall timestamps, artifact inspection and cleanup kept separate
guard readings and failures retained as safety, not GPU memory metrics
statistics: finite median/min/max/range of eligible measured values per exact metric and modality
prohibited: in-process cache-warm or true cold-start claims

numerical_report.pair_policy: All six unordered H3 pairs, with the three warmup-containing pairs separately labeled/excluded from measured-only variation summaries. Missing/invalid pairs remain present with reasons. No output-dependent pair selection.
numerical_report.h3_video: All56 frames with source-probed PTS/duration and dimensions, no scale/crop/interpolation/temporal shift. Existing pinned codec software decode + existing PNG/frame numerical APIs. Bound derived extraction to each original MP4 and recheck complete concatenated RGB hash against its original guarded inspection; never infer extraction completeness from a supplied PNG list alone. Per-frame and whole-sequence errors with exact denominators. Alignment mismatch is unavailable, not coerced.
numerical_report.h3_audio: Original inspection full-PCM hashes, stream rate/channels/count/duration retained. Bounded unforced f32le decode with same pinned tool/settings and cross-check against original PCM hash. Exact sample-index/channel/PTS alignment only; count/timeline mismatch remains unavailable. Finite float64-accumulated max/MAE/RMSE in decoded amplitude units, finite-value checks and denominators; no resampling, gain adjustment, trimming, lag fit, fabricated PSNR or acoustic-quality claim.
numerical_report.classification: Exact decoded equality or different-unbounded only. No tolerance chosen/adapted. Error magnitude is output variation, not perceptual quality or causal attribution.
numerical_report.visual: Require and inspect each new H3 first/middle/last preview plus its mandatory all56-frame contact sheet from the bounded owned analysis path. Bind exact hashes, source frames and reviewer limitations; no acoustic listening, perceptual quality or rigid-motion claim without actual independent evidence.

comparability.rule: No equal-null or equal-redacted inference. Record exact available workload/build/source/tool bindings alongside unknown fields. Same seed and same declared settings do not establish deterministic output or a controlled same-work performance baseline.

bounds.storage_enforcement_note: Planning/admission budget, not an atomic filesystem quota. Existing native guards/file limits stay unchanged. Check bounded owned usage before/after CPU phases and before each new attempt; preserve partial outputs and stop rather than delete evidence or exceed plan knowingly. No disk inspection performed during proposal.
bounds.offline_policy: No decode truncation accepted as completeness. Same original OwnedProcess custody/fork/network/write confinement, no GPU/native imports; all analysis helpers settle. One helper at a time, after native sampling, not alongside another model sample.

authority.build_scope: CPU-only standalone collector, fixed H3-only offline reporter and private scalar/path helper rebinding against the already qualified frozen-main rlib. No guardian/native rebuild, model import/call, service action or observer activation during implementation/qualification.

contract_gaps: StudyPlan expands baseline/candidate/control and is not used; this is a separately fixed H3-only offline analysis, not a generic executor.
Original full RGB/PCM acceptance is retained. Bounded later extraction and all56-frame contact sheet must bind the original hashes; no historical media may become a study row.
Existing numerical functions are calculators only; preserve neutral left_slot/right_slot records and all unknowns.

prior_stopped_cohort.status: incomplete and closed to further admission
prior_stopped_cohort.qwen: Valid descriptive subset retained separately, not pooled with or relabeled as rows of this study.
prior_stopped_cohort.h3: All four old H3 slots remain unrun. Every slot in this new study must come from a new original authorized attempt.

clock_collection.kind: standalone finite owned collector independent of Eval-client lifetime
clock_collection.process_domain: One freshly created original collector process and unique monotonic domain for all four attempts. No persisted-state replay or domain reconstruction. A replacement client may reconnect only to that same live actor.
clock_collection.commands: Collector records execution/readiness brackets and source identities only. Never executes commands, observers, models, service actions or host scans.
clock_collection.transport: Private bounded local IPC with exact study root, source and domain binding; qualified before native admission.
clock_collection.ownership: Retain original creation, finite lifetime and external owner settlement. No self-attested leader reaping; no restored or invented original timestamps.
clock_collection.admission: Require sufficient remaining collector lifetime for the declared command/readiness ceiling before a bracket starts; domain/sequence/identity/record failures prevent subsequent native admission.
